metadata.description: NPM unpacked-size cap of 20,132,659 bytes (20% above the 16 MiB cap, which was itself raised from 15 MiB on 2026-10-22 after feature work used up the earlier headroom). The external source maps (about 9 MB, unused at runtime) still do not ship in the tarball (package.json files negation, enforced by packed-runtime-assets), so a regression that re-packs them (23,061,125 bytes) still fails by a wide margin
